integration_decision.name: TWO_PHASE_GENERATION_DELTA_ORACLE_REQUIRED_BEFORE_RACE_VERDICT
integration_decision.new_contract_improvement: Source-verified runner writes latest.json and audit_latest.json BEFORE anata_latest.json. At A_paused, capture and hash/parse A's already-written latest/audit outputs and assert anata_latest absent. After appending PIT rowB and while A stays paused, B must complete and all three B outputs must parse. Require B latest/audit SHA256 to differ from A baseline, and B anata source_evidence scoring effective.source_record_id=rowB; if these discriminators fail, classify INVALID_TEST rather than claim generation coherence. Snapshot all three B hashes and parsed JSON before releasing A. After A resumes, compare final all three hashes to B: final anata missing rowB or reverting to A is STALE_HANDOFF_REPRODUCED; other mismatches OTHER_MIXED_GENERATION; exact B triple NO_OVERWRITE. Ensure both child exitcodes zero, compact Queue results, spawn-safe Events, bounded waits and whole-test finally release/terminate/join. Same as_of_ms is not generation identity.
integration_decision.reason: Without an A baseline and verified B delta in latest/audit, unchanged or coincidentally equal compact/audit outputs can produce a false three-output generation oracle. This improves the frozen no-network test contract without altering Specialist code or claiming runtime reproduction.
